articles.title: Two more victims of corrupt police officer have convictions quashed
Man charged after June Kenwood shooting that seriously injured a 15-year-old boy
articles.description:
A 48-year-old Chicago man has been charged with attempted murder after shooting at three people, including a 15-year-old boy who was seriously wounded in June in the Kenwood neighborhood.

Shauntay Sardin, 48, was charged with three counts of attempted murder because there were two additional victims who were not shot, and aggravated battery, police said.

On June 20 in the 700 block of East 47th Street, Sardin allegedly opened fire at three people, including a 15-year-old boy who was shot and seriously injured, police said.

Sardin, of the 1900 block of East 72nd Place in South Shore and who was arrested Monday in the 5100 block of South Indiana Avenue, was due for a detention hearing Tuesday at the Leighton Criminal Courthouse
